subject: Azure Private Offer — rev-share & term deviations requested by Orpheus Analytics
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orpheus-analytics.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Draft Azure private offer & capacity ask

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive demo earlier. Per our conversation attached is a draft private-offer we can submit to Azure on your behalf. Key points from our side:
- 24-month term, annual billing
- List pricing with proposed customer discount: 25% off list
- Marketplace rev-share: we modeled standard Azure marketplace fee at 20% (shown in revshare_calculation.xlsx) and proposed channel split with Orpheus at 15% of Redwood net revenue (we can adjust if you have a preferred partner split)
- Data handling and deletion clause: standard Redwood text, but you asked for 5 year retention allowance for audits — flagged for legal

Please review the attached SOW and the offer draft. If you confirm budget and signoff, I can initiate the private-offer submission to Microsoft with the attached offer doc.

Two items I anticipate needing to escalate: (1) Orpheus asked for a 30% discount and extended 36-month price protection, and (2) they requested a modification to our indemnity clause around third-party data processors. If they push those, I’ll need a quick decision from finance/legal/executive.

Next step: can you confirm whether 25% is acceptable to Orpheus or if they will insist on 30%? If it’s the latter, I’ll route for approval.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orpheus-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: azure-marketplace@partner.microsoft.com
Date: 2027-02-20T10:04:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Draft Azure private offer & capacity ask

Rishi —

Thanks for the draft. Quick answers:
- Orpheus can accept 24 months, annual billing is fine.
- We need a 30% off list discount to hit our internal budget for Y1.
- Rev-share: we expected a 50/50 split on net subscription margin with our channel partner (they drive the Azure procurement). If Azure fees (marketplace) are 20%, we want the net split after fees to be 50/50.
- Legal: we need a limited change to the data retention clause to allow up to 36 months retention for compliance audits (not 5 years). We can compromise at 36 months.

If you can get to 30% and confirm the rev-share math, procurement can sign quickly. Otherwise we’ll need to evaluate alternate procurement paths.

Elena
VP, Procurement | Orpheus Analytics
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-20T13:18:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft Azure private offer & capacity ask — Orpheus pushing 30% and rev-share alignment

Laura / Connor —

Forwarding Orpheus' asks. TL;DR: they want 30% off list (we proposed 25%) and want the channel partner split to be 50/50 on net after Azure fees. They’re willing to compromise on retention at 36 months.

Please see attached revshare_calculation.xlsx that shows current modeling: with a 20% Azure fee, 30% customer discount, and a 50/50 split between Redwood and partner on net, Redwood net ARR falls below our minimum threshold if we accept the partner split at that level for a 24-month commitment.

Questions I have for deal desk:
- Can we approve 30% for this deal if we require a higher minimum commitment (e.g., 36 months) or an initial non-refundable deposit?
- Alternatively, can we reduce the partner share to 40% so Redwood net ARRs remain acceptable?

Connor — can legal sign off on the 36-month retention compromise? If not, what language would be acceptable?

Rishi
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-21T08:47:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft Azure private offer & capacity ask — Orpheus pushing 30% and rev-share alignment

Rishi / Laura —

Legal is comfortable with a 36-month retention window limited to audit/review only, provided we add clear retention deletion triggers and an approved subprocessors list. I attached a redline of the data clause in Azure_Private_Offer_Draft.docx. We will not accept full indemnity changes; we can offer a tailored limited indemnity for breaches caused by Redwood or our certified subprocessors.

From a contracting perspective, the retention tweak is a manageable exception.

Connor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
(attachment: Azure_Private_Offer_Draft.docx - redline)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-21T11:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft Azure private offer & capacity ask — Orpheus pushing 30% and rev-share alignment

Team —

I ran the numbers against our minimum net ARR floor. With the customer's requested 30% discount + a 50/50 split with partner after a 20% Azure fee, Redwood net margin falls ~22% below our threshold on a 24-month term. Two options that get us back in range:
1) Approve 30% only if Orpheus signs a 36-month term with annual billing and a 25% non-refundable upfront payment (this improves cash and CLTV).
2) Approve 30% for 24 months only if partner rev-share is capped at 40% of net (not 50%).

If the execs prefer to keep term at 24 months and maintain the partner's 50/50 split, we'd need to increase price elsewhere or decline.

I recommend we route for Marissa's approval with both options presented so execs can pick.

Laura
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
(attachment: revshare_calculation.xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-22T16:03:00-05:00
Subject: RE: Draft Azure private offer & capacity ask — Orpheus pushing 30% and rev-share alignment

Team —

Thanks for the clear options. I approve the following one-time exception for Orpheus:
- Accept 30% off list for a 36-month term with annual billing.
- Require a 20% non-refundable deposit at contract signature (applied to year 1 invoice).
- Cap partner rev-share at 40% of Redwood net (post-Azure fee).
- Legal to include Connor's redline for 36-month retention limited to audits with strict deletion triggers and approved subprocessors.

Rishi — please update the private-offer draft to reflect the 36-month term and deposit, and confirm with Orpheus that the partner rev-share cap is acceptable. Once they confirm, create the private offer in Azure and send a DocuSign with the SOW. I’m comfortable with this concession for a strategic account if we get the longer term + deposit + rev-share cap.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
(attachments: approval_note.txt)
